info.name: FinTrack — Finnet Backend API
info.description:
Complete collection built from the implemented Express routes, not only the OpenAPI index.

QUICK START
1. Import the collection and select the Render or Local environment (optional; collection defaults to Render).
2. Set email/password locally in Postman. Keep the cookie jar enabled. There is no Bearer token to copy: login sets ft_access and ft_refresh HttpOnly cookies.
3. Existing verified account: send Login. If requiresMfa=true, enter mfaCode then send Verify MFA challenge. New account: Register, open your actual inbox, copy token into verificationToken, Verify email, then Login.
4. Create portfolio captures portfolioId; Create BUY/SELL capture IDs. Test summaries/receipts/exports afterwards.

CSRF: a collection pre-request script gets a signed token before every mutation and adds X-CSRF-Token. Origin matches frontendOrigin. Cookie jar must retain the matching ft_csrf cookie. Use Postman Desktop/Desktop Agent for localhost. Render Free cold starts may require a request timeout of at least 60 seconds.

Email/Google/MFA require functioning providers. Generic 200 responses from resend/forgot-password do not prove an account exists or an email arrived. Manually paste tokens/codes from real emails; this collection cannot read your inbox or complete Google account selection. Configure googleIdToken with a fresh credential obtained through your app.

Send requests individually. This collection includes real account changes, permission changes and deletes; it is a route reference, not a safe whole-collection production runner. Mutation requests can send actual notifications. Use a test account and fictional portfolio data.

Sensitive variables are intentionally blank. Do not save API keys/JWT secrets/SMTP credentials here. Session cookies and runtime token values are private; clear them before exporting a used collection.

request.description: Reports Google client ID and delivery transport, never provider secrets.
Creates an account and sends confirmation email. A delivery failure can leave an unverified account; use Resend verification rather than registering again.
Generic 200 for unknown/already-verified accounts. Does not prove delivery.
Paste token from the verification URL, not the whole URL. Single-use, 24-hour expiry.
Cookie jar stores sessions. If data.requiresMfa=true, run MFA verification before protected requests.

item.name: Google sign in or create account

request.description: Fresh Google ID token required. Existing password accounts are not linked automatically. acceptTerms=true is included as in the frontend.
Requires the ft_access cookie; no Authorization header.
Rotates refresh cookies. Reusing an old refresh token revokes its session; keep the cookie jar enabled.
For sign-in challenges, successful verification sets session cookies. Also confirms enabling MFA.
60-second resend cooldown; use the code from the latest email.
Verified accounts receive reset/set link. Public response is generic.
Single-use email token, 30-minute expiry. Revokes existing sessions; log in again afterwards.
Authenticated Google-only account without a password. Sends a link; may reject an account that already has a password.
Uses the set-password token from email. Log in again afterwards.
Requires current password. Revokes sessions and clears cookies. This request changes credentials.
Optional avatarUrl accepts a PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 data URL (max decoded size 1 MB), or null. Other profile fields are rejected.
Auto-captures challengeId. Enter mfaCode and run Verify MFA challenge to finish enabling MFA.
Requires recent MFA or valid current password. Changes account security preference.
Full body required. Currency cannot change after transactions exist.
Chronological moving-average ledger. Valuation uses latest recorded trade price, not live market prices.
Owner/admin only. Target account must already exist and be verified. Global viewer role still forbids writes.

request.description: today is computed in Africa/Nairobi before sending. Server trims/uppercases instrument and validates all fields.
Run BUY first. Server replays historical ledger and rejects any trade that invalidates a later SELL.
Current list controller returns the full ledger. Filtering/sorting is done by the frontend; export.xlsx supports query filters.
Receipt data for printing in the frontend. This endpoint returns JSON, not a PDF or tax invoice.
Use Send and Download in Postman. Optional filters: instrument, type, from, to, sort, direction. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; sort: tradeDate/instrument/quantity/unitPrice/amount; direction asc/desc.
Expect error.details with field/message pairs.
